verdict.rationale: Filee is an offline file converter. A desktop file tool could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows AI analysis, insights or suggestions from user data. Features like background removal, Trace to SVG and automatic multi-step route finding are conversion operations, not AI-generated insights, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
